name: Green Fluorite Tumbled Stones
description: Translucent green stones with natural zoning and internal planes, traditionally associated with focus, order, learning, discernment, and clear organisation.
alt: Five translucent green fluorite tumble stones on deep green slate
note: Representative render. Fluorite is soft, brittle, and has easy cleavage; protect it from impacts and harsh cleaners. Colour zoning, shape, and size vary by batch.
